_comment: Garage Bose presets 1-6. Plain http only (the SoundTouch renderer rejects https). Same URLs as bose_out/scripts.yaml, the HA template sensor and the Morpheus bridge (task_executor.GARAGE_PRESETS) — HA recognises the playing preset by this exact URL, so keep all copies in step. freq/ps only place the station on the garage page's FM dial (made-up positions, not real FM frequencies); the other copies don't need them.
